topic: Helping a Parent Set Up a Phone

script.title: SETTING UP DAD'S NEW PHONE
script.scene_zh: 家裡餐桌 · 設定新手機
script.story_hook: A daughter sets up her dad's brand new phone.
script.intro_zh: Anna 在餐桌幫爸爸把全新的手機設定好。
script.welcome_en: Hey everyone, welcome back! Today we're setting up a new phone.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎回來！今天我們要幫一位爸爸設定新手機。
script.outro: That's one phone, sorted! Listen again and repeat after me.
script.outro_zh: 一支手機就搞定啦！再聽一次，跟著我唸。
script.practice_intro_en: Time to practice: hear a line, then say it.
script.practice_intro_zh: 輪到練習了：聽一句，跟著說一句。
script.char_a_description: a cheerful East Asian woman in her early thirties with chin-length dark hair with honey highlights, wearing a mustard cardigan and round glasses, gesturing with both hands while explaining
script.char_b_description: a stocky retired man in his mid-sixties with close-cropped white hair and thick eyebrows, wearing a navy fleece vest over checked flannel, squinting at the screen
script.youtube_title: 【📱👨教爸媽用手機英文】「isn't so scary after all」怎麼說？放慢語氣實戰教學｜🎧Setting Up a Parent's Phone
script.youtube_title_en: "This Phone Isn't So Scary After All" — Helping a Parent Set Up a Phone
script.youtube_description:
幫爸媽設定新手機，不知從何說起？這段爸爸與 Anna 在餐桌上的對話，教你放大字體、連無線網路、存電話與打視訊。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就能邊做邊說。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Helping a parent with a new phone? This kitchen-table scene teaches you how to make text bigger, join the home wifi, save a contact, and start a video call. 18 lines of warm everyday American English with IPA and Traditional Chinese, then a repeat-after-me section to build your own confidence.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】📱👨教爸媽手機英文｜放大字體・連無線網路・存電話按鍵｜聽完就會教｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
爸媽拿到新手機，要從哪裡教起？
「字體放大」「連網路」用英文怎麼講？
講太快他們聽不懂，該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進家裡的餐桌，跟著 Anna 從放大字體、連上無線網路、存好聯絡人，一路練到打通視訊，全程都是慢而清楚的美式日常英語。

你會聽到：
🔤 教操作步驟：例如「let's make the text bigger」、「Just tap it slowly」。
📶 連網與存電話：例如「let's join our home wifi」、「I already saved it for you」。
🫶 給耐心的鼓勵：例如「Take your time」、「We'll practice it every day」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把這些教學用語變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次把手機交給爸媽，你也能慢慢教、開心用！
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a big bright phone screen

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay Dad, brand new phone, ready to learn?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ dæd brænd nju foʊn ˈridi tə lɜrn/
dialogue.zh: 好了爸，全新的手機，準備學了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready when you are. It looks huge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi wɛn ju ɑr ɪt lʊks hju dʒ/
dialogue.zh: 你隨時可以開始。它看起來好大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, let's make the text bigger for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst lɛts meɪk ðə tɛkst ˈbɪɡər fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 第一步，先把字體放大一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do. My eyes aren't what they were.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz du maɪ aɪz ˈɑrənt wʌt ðeɪ wɜr/
dialogue.zh: 拜託了，我的眼睛不比從前囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See this Aa button? Just tap it slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðɪs eɪ eɪ ˈbʌtən dʒʌst tæp ɪt ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 看到這個 Aa 按鈕了嗎？慢慢點一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this? Wow, that's way clearer already.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs waʊ ðæts weɪ ˈklɪrər ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 這樣嗎？哇，已經清楚太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right? Next, let's join our home wifi.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt nɛkst lɛts dʒoɪn ɑr hoʊm ˈwaɪˌfaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對吧？接下來連家裡的無線網路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that the long password on the router?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ðə lɔŋ ˈpæswɜrd ɑn ðə ˈraʊtər/
dialogue.zh: 就是路由器上那組長密碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yep, but I already saved it for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp bʌt aɪ ɔlˈrɛdi ˈseɪvd ɪt fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 對，不過我已經先幫你存好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, that helps. So what's next?
dialogue.zh: 這樣就好多了。那接下來是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's save my number so you can text me.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts seɪv maɪ ˈnʌmbər soʊ ju kæn tɛkst mi/
dialogue.zh: 我們來把我的號碼存進去，你好傳訊息給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I call you with just one touch?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kɔl ju wɪð dʒʌst wʌn tʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我按一下就打得通給你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, put me in Favorites up top.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈpʊt mi ɪn ˈfeɪvərɪts ʌp tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 可以，把我加在最上面的最愛清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold on, how do I type with this thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn haʊ du aɪ taɪp wɪð ðɪs θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，這個要怎麼打字啊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time. We'll practice it every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔr taɪm wil ˈpræktɪs ɪt ˈɛvri deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，我們每天練一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay. Can we try a video call with Mom?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ kæn wi traɪ ə ˈvɪdioʊ kɔl wɪð mɑm/
dialogue.zh: 好。我們可以試著跟你媽打一通視訊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, Grandma will love seeing your big letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ˈɡrænmə wɪl lʌv ˈsinɪŋ jɔr bɪɡ ˈlɛtərz/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，奶奶一定會愛上這大字體。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, this phone isn't so scary after all.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðɪs foʊn ˈɪzənt soʊ ˈskɛri ˈæftər ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這手機也沒有那麼可怕嘛。
